narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: Neutral Apple materials, IKN accents.**

Updated on 20 October 2026 following the user's typography and accent-color revision. White panels, cool gray canvas and graphite text now lead both apps. Plus Jakarta Sans gives headings a distinct voice; the platform system stack keeps forms, tables and controls familiar. Aksara navy, blue and gold are accents, with the original institutional emblem and photograph retained.

This is a code-led preview, not an approved raster comp. Shared tokens and styles are authoritative. Application state, validation, routing, permission scopes and backend boundaries are unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral surfaces with selective blue/gold accents.
Plus Jakarta Sans headings, platform system operational text.
Purposeful static glass and accessible task feedback.
dos: Keep broad surfaces neutral and IKN colors selective.
Use the display face for hierarchy; system text for operations.
Preserve status semantics, focus containment and responsive table boundaries.
Keep one self-hosted 27.35 KB Latin variable font with swap and license.
donts: Don't replace the pinned visual world with a generic style or invent institutional claims, assets or token ramps.

Don't infer production readiness from this handoff. The preview is synthetic in-memory development data; the real HTTP new-flow adapter intentionally fails until contracts are reconciled. Go backend code was untouched.
Don't treat screenshots as an approved comp or claim an Impeccable engine/detector pass. The engine was unavailable in the sandbox; source inspection and manual browser review supplied evidence.
